title: Harvest and Hymn
author: Lior Voss
blurb: Vesper Sterling, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
